svg.text: On stock memory every card peaks for efficiency well below its stock cap -- at 210 W, 148 W, 130 W
NOT a controlled comparison. The 4070 Ti SUPER was swept on Linux with caps set by nvidia-smi and power read from NVML; the other two by MXBM's own --tune on
Windows, in another machine with different cooling. Cross-card distances carry all of that. What survives it is each curve's SHAPE and where its own peak sits.
sol/s is CPU-verified solutions in every series. x is the cap the card was given, not what it drew.
